fields.Name: T052 - Dashboard Category Create Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises the New-dropdown split (Dashboard vs Category), the create-category dialog, and the onCategoryCreate save path that renders a folder — distinct from creating a dashboard (T105) and from category-tree navigation (T106) which only browses existing categories.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 35,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "The 'New' button opens a dropdown offering both Dashboard and Category options",
    "Choosing Category opens a 'Create Category' dialog with a Name field (required) and optional Description, plus Create/Cancel",
    "After entering a name and clicking Create, a new category/folder appears in the dashboard browser (as a folder card or row)",
    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
